China King Menu: Discover the Best Dishes for Your Next Takeout

If you’re craving delicious Chinese food, China King offers a wide variety of traditional and specialty dishes that will satisfy your hunger. From flavorful beef and pork dishes to mouth-watering seafood and vegetarian options, China King provides an expansive menu that covers everything from classic fried rice and lo mein to unique specialties like moo shu and chop suey. Whether you’re dining in, ordering takeout, or opting for delivery, this guide offers a complete breakdown of the best dishes China King has to offer.

About China King Restaurant

China King is a well-known restaurant that specializes in providing authentic Chinese food to its customers. With a menu that spans a range of classic Chinese dishes, it’s a favorite spot for both locals and visitors. The restaurant offers easy takeout and delivery services, ensuring that your favorite dishes are just a click or call away.

China King Menu Overview

The menu at China King features a variety of options that cater to every palate. From hearty beef and pork dishes to flavorful seafood and vegetarian meals, you’ll find something for every craving. The menu also includes appetizers, soups, specialty dishes, and combination platters, making it perfect for both lunch and dinner.

Appetizers: Start Your Meal Off Right

China King offers a selection of appetizers that provide the perfect way to begin your meal. From crispy egg rolls to savory crab rangoons, the appetizers are packed with flavor and are ideal for sharing.

Popular Appetizers:

  • Egg Rolls: Crispy on the outside, with a savory filling of pork and vegetables.
  • Crab Rangoons: Creamy crabmeat and cream cheese wrapped in a crispy wonton shell.
  • Fried Shrimp: Lightly battered and fried shrimp served with dipping sauce.

Soups: Warm and Flavorful

China King’s selection of soups is perfect for starting your meal or as a light meal on its own. These soups are rich in flavor and offer a great balance of savory and comforting ingredients.

Popular Soups:

  • Wonton Soup: Tender wontons in a savory broth with scallions and crispy noodles.
  • Hot and Sour Soup: A spicy and tangy soup with tofu, mushrooms, and bamboo shoots.
  • Egg Drop Soup: A classic soup with silky egg strands in a light chicken broth.

Beef and Pork Dishes: Rich and Hearty

For meat lovers, China King offers a variety of beef and pork dishes that are full of bold flavors. These dishes are cooked with fresh vegetables and seasoned with delicious sauces, including classic garlic sauce and brown sauce.

Popular Beef and Pork Dishes:

  • Beef with Broccoli: Tender slices of beef stir-fried with fresh broccoli in a rich brown sauce.
  • Pork with Garlic Sauce: Juicy pork slices stir-fried in a savory garlic sauce with vegetables.
  • Sweet and Sour Pork: Crispy fried pork pieces served with a tangy sweet and sour sauce.

Seafood Specialties: Fresh and Flavorful

For seafood lovers, China King provides a range of seafood dishes featuring shrimp, scallops, crab, and lobster. These dishes are prepared with traditional Chinese sauces, including the signature house special sauce.

Popular Seafood Dishes:

  • Shrimp with Lobster Sauce: Large shrimp cooked in a savory lobster sauce with peas and carrots.
  • Jumbo Shrimp with Garlic Sauce: Plump shrimp stir-fried in a flavorful garlic sauce with vegetables.
  • Seafood Delight: A combination of shrimp, scallops, and crab meat stir-fried with mixed vegetables.

Vegetarian Dishes: Fresh and Healthy

China King offers a wide selection of vegetarian dishes that are made with fresh vegetables and flavorful sauces. These dishes are perfect for those looking for lighter meal options without compromising on taste.

Popular Vegetarian Dishes:

  • Mixed Vegetables in Brown Sauce: A healthy mix of vegetables stir-fried in a savory brown sauce.
  • Vegetable Lo Mein: Soft noodles stir-fried with mixed vegetables.
  • Moo Shu Vegetables: Shredded vegetables served with thin pancakes and hoisin sauce.

Fried Rice and Lo Mein: Classic Chinese Favorites

Fried rice and lo mein are classic staples of Chinese cuisine, and China King offers some of the best options around. Whether you’re a fan of shrimp fried rice or chicken lo mein, these dishes are cooked with fresh ingredients and packed with flavor.

Popular Fried Rice and Lo Mein Dishes:

  • Shrimp Fried Rice: Fragrant fried rice stir-fried with shrimp, peas, carrots, and eggs.
  • Chicken Lo Mein: Soft noodles stir-fried with tender chicken and fresh vegetables.
  • Pork Fried Rice: Savory fried rice made with pork, onions, and soy sauce.

Combination Plates: Great Value Meals

If you’re looking for a well-rounded meal that includes a bit of everything, the combination plates at China King are an excellent choice. These plates come with your choice of entree, fried rice, and an egg roll, making it a complete and satisfying meal.

Popular Combination Plates:

  • General Tso’s Chicken Combo: Spicy and sweet chicken served with fried rice and an egg roll.
  • Beef with Broccoli Combo: Tender beef stir-fried with broccoli, served with fried rice and an egg roll.
  • Sweet and Sour Chicken Combo: Crispy chicken with sweet and sour sauce, fried rice, and an egg roll.

Lunch Specials: Quick and Affordable

For a quick and affordable meal, China King offers a variety of lunch specials that are perfect for those on the go. These specials include an entree, fried rice, and a side of soup or an egg roll.

Popular Lunch Specials:

  • Chicken with Broccoli Lunch Special: A smaller portion of chicken and broccoli stir-fried in a light sauce, served with fried rice and a choice of soup or egg roll.
  • Shrimp Lo Mein Lunch Special: Soft noodles stir-fried with shrimp and vegetables, served with fried rice and an egg roll.
  • Sweet and Sour Pork Lunch Special: Crispy pork with sweet and sour sauce, fried rice, and an egg roll.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. Does China King offer delivery?

Yes, China King offers delivery and takeout services through their website or third-party apps like Uber Eats and Grubhub.

2. What are some of the most popular items at China King?

Some of the most popular dishes include the General Tso’s Chicken, Shrimp with Lobster Sauce, and Beef with Broccoli.

3. Does China King offer vegetarian options?

Yes, China King has a wide variety of vegetarian options, including Mixed Vegetables in Brown Sauce, Vegetable Lo Mein, and Moo Shu Vegetables.

4. Are lunch specials available every day?

Yes, lunch specials are available every day from 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

5. Can I order online from China King?

Yes, you can easily place your order online through China King’s website or through third-party delivery services.
